verdict.rationale: Pipedream provides docs with code snippets (docs-4, docs-5) and a live chat app (chat.pipedream.com) where users can try MCP tool calls interactively (docs-9), but there is no evidence of a dedicated interactive API reference/playground with runnable examples for the 3,000+ APIs. missing for 10: an actual interactive API explorer or sandboxed runnable code examples beyond a chat demo, independent confirmation of such a reference existing.
